body: Run the shell-out ingestion spike (choice 0100 ac-01): prototype CSV/Parquet ingest via the external duckdb CLI (sample + count/approx_distinct/min/max in one query); verify mac/linux/windows duckdb.exe; benchmark vs csv-crate on a large + small file. No compile risk.
Add depends_on duckdb to Homebrew tap formula at next release
Universal free-stats + neural short-circuit (choice 0100 ac-04, deferred from v0.6.32)

KICKOFF BRIEF (start with /design): Two separable pieces, gate them differently.

(1) FREE-STATS PLUMBING — low risk, no behaviour change. The duckdb ingestion scan (read_csv_input, crates/finetype-cli/src/profile_io.rs) already runs; add full-column aggregates (count(*), approx_count_distinct, min, max — SUMMARIZE-style) in the same query and thread them to the column-statistics rule layer for EVERY input (CSV/Parquet/table). Closes the deferred column-statistics-lever ac-05/ac-07 (that spec is closed; this is the bridge).

(2) NEURAL SHORT-CIRCUIT — behaviour change, MUST be gold + corpus-honest gated. When a full-column stat is DECISIVE (binary domain, genuine increment signature, single/low cardinality), skip the neural Sense pass. Conservative only: skip ONLY when decisive, else neural still runs — over-eager skip = silent misclassification. Value-based rule (choice 0048/0096). Precedent: increment_substance_veto (v0.6.31) is the first full-column-stat rule; follow its gold+corpus-honest gating pattern.

Measure: throughput with vs without short-circuit (the speed win), and gold headline + corpus-honest GO (the safety). Memories: cli-mcp-surface-parity is unrelated; see increment veto in CHANGELOG 0.6.31 and choice 0100 for the ingestion substrate.

DESIGN SETTLED (interview.md, 2026-06-17). Open question resolved: the decisive-stat conservatism bar is NOT chosen a priori — it EMERGES from a per-predicate sweep study. The short-circuit is a carve-out, not a global bet: serve the slice where a full-column stat is >=98% precise, fast, skipping the neural pass; neural handles the rest. Per candidate (increment, exact-binary, low-card->categorical, high-card->alnum): sweep a strictness knob, read {captured-count, slice precision on gold, corpus-honest verdict, throughput}; SHIP the skip at the LOOSEST setting holding slice precision >=0.98 AND corpus-honest GO AND no gold-headline regression. A predicate that can't reach 0.98 without relocating ships at most as a post-pass recall rule (neural vote intact). Pass-mark author-confirmed: >=98% on captured slice + whole-corpus gold non-regression + GO, all blocking. Reuse values_form_increment==Some(true) and exact-{0,1} affirmative predicates (already demote-validated). NEXT: /orb:spec to split ac-04 into (1) free-stats plumbing+parity [code], (2) sweep study [observation], (3) ship eligible skips + throughput [code+observation].
